clips.title: The story
paras: At Southshore Town Hall, Magistrate Henry Maleb directs the town’s affairs and defenses. It remains one of Lordaeron’s last centers of civil authority, while the Alliance struggles to hold ground in the plagued north.

Southshore Town Hall keeps human rule alive amid Lordaeron’s ruin. Magistrate Henry Maleb governs from his office, working with officials such as Kundric Zanden to secure supplies and preserve order. Undead press from nearby lands, Syndicate rogues threaten the region, and Hillsbrad’s border sees fierce skirmishes. From the hall, town leaders direct Southshore’s survival against these threats.
